notes: Same decode site as duplicate-server-ids-preserved.json (AppConfig.init(from:) line 744-746): two distinct server ids that happen to share the same standardized server_dir path also both survive decode unmerged. `server_dir`-collision handling (P5.7's restore-merge, which does compare standardized paths) lives in ConfigManager's recovery merge, not in AppConfig's own decoder -- this fixture pins that AppConfig itself is path-collision-agnostic too, just like it is id-collision-agnostic.
